messages:
Priya: Short sync from the postmortem follow-up: we need owners/timelines for GPU capacity fixes. Proposal below.

Evan: OK paste it.

Priya: Three tracks: 1) quota uplift (Evan), 2) scheduler tuning canary (Nora), 3) headroom definition + detection (Suresh). Plan in 72h, staging canaries in 1 sprint, rollout next sprint.

Nora: Will draft test matrix: preempt threshold, bin-packing, backfill window. Canary = prod instance type, 10% traffic.

Suresh: Headroom = static min per-region + dynamic 95th-percentile cushion. Add alert at 85% sustained for 10m. I'll add dashboards + smoke job.

Evan: I'll open quota ticket today and include cost delta. If cloud lead time >2w, Ops-Lead to allocate burst pool.

Ops-Lead: I can allocate a 7-day burst; will check approvals and reserved pool state.

SRE-Bot: Action RB-4001 created and linked. 72h checkpoint reminder set.

Priya: Timeline recap: T0 open tickets; +72h concrete plan; Sprint1 canaries+alerts; Sprint2 rollout+30-day regression check. Meeting tomorrow 10:30 for 20m.

Evan: Ticket: https://tickets.internal/INC-5789 assigned to cloud-quotas.

Nora: PR with scheduler tests posted: https://git.internal/scheduler/PR-27

Suresh: Headroom draft: https://docs.internal/headroom/v1-draft. Will add detection queries.

Priya: Add updates to remediation board and post blockers here. Thanks. :thumbsup:
